column1: # How a human password is put together. Tokens: {word} {Word} {WORD} {leet} {Leet} (a base word, as written, capitalised, upper case, with look-alike digits), {exact} (a whole common password), {name} {Name} (the given name), {user} (the username without its trailing digits), {year} {yy} (the birth year, four or two digits), {num} (a number people like) and {sym} (a symbol). Each token draws on its own, so {word}{word} is two words. Authored shares.
